You will hear Mia and her dad talking about lunch for a picnic.
Dad: Shall we have our picnic on Saturday?
Mia: I have a school game then. Can we go on Sunday?
Dad: Yes. We can leave at eleven and eat at twelve.
Mia: Can we make sandwiches?
Dad: Yes. Would you like meat?
Mia: I prefer cheese. There is some in the fridge.
Dad: Good. We have bread, but we need some tomatoes for the sandwiches.
Mia: I can get them at the shop.
Dad: We also need a drink.
Mia: Orange juice?
Dad: We can take water instead. It is a hot day.
Mia: Can we sit beside the lake?
Dad: That place has no trees. Let’s sit under the big tree near the gate.
Mia: All right. I can put the food in our bag.
Dad: Thanks. I will carry it.
